results.question: Q3101
results.result: Triangle-free commuting graphs of finite bands are bipartite. In a finite completely regular semigroup with triangle-free commuting graph, noncentral idempotents induce a bipartite graph, and every odd cycle contains at least two nonidempotent involutions whose subgroup identities are central.
results.scope: All finite bands, plus the stated necessary conditions in the full finite completely regular class.
results.primary_location: Problem 7.3 p.28; definitions pp.3-5; even-girth Theorem 3.5 pp.16-20.
results.prior_repo_result: No earlier result linked from Q3101 at round start.
results.remaining_gap: Odd girths at least five for general finite completely regular semigroups remain unresolved.

results.question: Q3102
results.result: Every length-three left path in a finite completely regular semigroup yields a length-two left path. Thus no finite completely regular semigroup has knit degree three.
results.scope: The exact finite completely regular existence question; a nonexistence theorem, not a counterexample construction.
results.primary_location: Problem 7.4 p.28; left-path definition p.4; Theorem 6.3 p.27.
results.prior_repo_result: No earlier result linked from Q3102 at round start.
results.remaining_gap: No mathematical gap identified in the written proof or separate internal review; historical priority is not certified.
